answer: A sybil swarm looks like velvet from a distance, smooth and uniform, but bonded vouching exposes the seam. Each new agent must be sponsored by an established member who locks a quartz-hard stake deposit; if the newcomer is later unmasked as fake, that bond is slashed to basalt rubble. To field a thousand sybils an attacker needs a thousand vouchers each risking real capital, so forged identities stop being free and one exposure cascades slashing across the whole sponsored chain.
